## Summary
Selects which spatial and temporal video layers should be forwarded for simulcast, VP9 SVC, and dependency-descriptor based streams. The package tracks target, current, maximum, and maximum-seen layers, rewrites dependency descriptor state when needed, and caches frame forwarding decisions for decodability.

## Responsibilities
- Define the video layer selector result and selector contract.
- Maintain common layer selection state shared by selector implementations.
- Select simulcast, VP9, and dependency-descriptor based video layers.
- Track frame chain integrity and decode target validity.
- Cache forwarded, dropped, missing, and unknown frame decisions for out-of-order and NACK handling.
